parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of metal, slender and elongated, connecting the frame to the ear area.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the eyeglasses on the user's ear and helps maintain stability and comfort during wear.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward for storage or open outward for wearing.

parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of metal, similar to the left leg, connecting the frame to the ear area.
parts.Functional_description: It provides balance and support, ensuring the eyeglasses stay properly aligned on the user's face.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward for compact storage or open outward for wearing.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame and Lenses)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the eyeglasses, including the frame and lenses, primarily made of plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the lenses in place and provides the main structure for vision correction or protection.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed and rigid, serving as the central support to which the legs are attached via hinges.
